comparison.objective: Identify and pack items omitted by a changing human contribution, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Adaptive object selection and packing; no evidenced fine tool insertion, retained adjustment, or dynamic validation.
comparison.success_condition: Remaining items are identified and packed; setup and scoring are explicitly missing. Candidate has physical safety and cycle-performance thresholds.
comparison.reason: Adaptive division of packing work is a different tested ability from mechanical commissioning.
